sources.title: Luma's fictional parcel desk rules
sources.text: At Luma's fictional parcel desk, a red tag means hold a parcel for inspection. A blue tag means send it to the shelf. A red-tagged parcel must be inspected before shelving, even if its label also has a blue tag. These rules apply only to this fictional desk.

sources.title: Monday pilot excerpt at Luma's fictional parcel desk
sources.text: This excerpt describes only Monday's pilot at Luma's fictional parcel desk. Six parcels arrived: four with red tags and two with blue tags. All six eventually reached the shelf after any required inspection. The excerpt contains no information about other days, handling times, costs, or customer outcomes.
